user.title: Smart Service Alarm
user.description: Creates an alarm panel with a personal PIN for every user - or only the personal PINs, without an alarm panel (for example to protect a dashboard view in a home without this alarm). Modes, delays and sensors checked when arming are set later in the options.

data_description.name: Name of the alarm panel, for example Home.
data_description.rodzaj: An alarm panel with PINs, or only the PINs (no alarm panel; it can be turned on later in the options, the PINs stay).

abort.pins_only_exists: Smart Service Alarm already keeps the PINs without an alarm panel. To add the alarm panel, turn it on in that entry's options - the PINs stay.
abort.panel_keeps_pins: A Smart Service Alarm panel is already configured and keeps the PINs.

data_description.exit_delay: Time to leave after arming (arming state).
data_description.entry_delay: Time to disarm after a trigger before the alarm sounds (pending state).
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm lasts; afterwards the panel returns to the armed mode.
data_description.code_arm_required: When off, arming without a PIN is allowed (for example by an automation). A PIN that is given must always be correct.
data_description.sensors: Arming is refused while any of these sensors is open or has no reading.

piny.title: PINs only
piny.description: This entry keeps only the users' PINs, without an alarm panel. Turn on the alarm panel to arm and disarm with these PINs; the PINs stay.

error.not_disarmed: Change the settings after disarming the alarm.

locked_out.message: Too many wrong attempts. Try again at {godzina}.

mode_disabled.message: This mode is disabled in the alarm settings.

pin_taken.message: Another household member already uses this PIN — choose a different one.

pin_format.message: The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.

pin_trivial.message: This PIN is too easy to guess (repeated or consecutive digits) — choose a different one.

user_required.message: This action requires a signed-in user.

admin_required.message: Only an administrator can do this.

own_pin_only.message: You can only set your own PIN.

first_pin_by_admin.message: Your first PIN is set by an administrator.

unknown_alarm.message: This is not a Smart Service Alarm panel.

choose_alarm.message: Several alarm panels are configured — select the alarm panel (entity_id).

set_pin.name: Set PIN
set_pin.description: Sets the alarm PIN of a user. An administrator can set it for anyone; a user can only change his own existing PIN, with the current PIN. The first PIN is set by an administrator.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the PIN.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: New PIN: 4 to 8 digits, different from the PINs of other users.

current_pin.name: Current PIN
current_pin.description: Required when a user changes his own existing PIN.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: Needed only when more than one alarm panel is configured.

clear_pin.name: Remove PIN
clear_pin.description: Removes the alarm PIN of a user (administrator only).

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: ID of the user whose PIN is removed.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: Needed only when more than one alarm panel is configured.

unlock.name: Unlock account
unlock.description: Lifts the wrong-PIN lockout of an account (administrator only).

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: ID of the locked account, or _bez_konta for calls without a user.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: Needed only when more than one alarm panel is configured.

status.name: PIN status
status.description: Returns for every user whether a PIN is set and until when the account is locked (administrator only). Never returns a PIN.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: Needed only when more than one alarm panel is configured.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: Triggers the alarm like alarm_trigger and stores the name of the sensor that caused it.

czujnik.name: Sensor
czujnik.description: Name of the sensor shown in the alarm and the logbook.
